## <mark>AI-Generated Code Policy (Vibe Coding)</mark>

<mark>If you are using AI tools to generate code ("Vibe Coding"), please note:</mark>

**We only accept code generated by the GPT-5.4 model.**

<mark>Pull requests containing code generated by other AI models (including other GPT versions, Claude, Gemini, or any other LLM) will be rejected. This policy helps us maintain consistency and quality standards across the codebase.</mark>

<mark>If you're unsure whether your AI-assisted code meets this requirement, please open an issue to discuss before submitting.</mark>
